arguments.value: Jeffrey L. Schmehl is a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. Born in 1955 in Reading, Pennsylvania, he earned a B.A. from Dickinson College in 1977 and a J.D. from the University of Toledo College of Law in 1980. He served as an assistant public defender in Berks County from 1980 to 1981, as an assistant district attorney in Berks County from 1981 to 1986, and in private practice in West Reading from 1981 to 1986 and in Reading from 1986 to 1997. He was solicitor for Berks County from 1989 to 1997 and later served as a judge of the Court of Common Pleas of Berks County from 1998 to 2013, including as president judge from 2007 to 2013.
